text:
alex: Heads-up — we just saw a miss-fanout spike from prefix cache after the latest kernel-selection rollout. Backend KV RPS jumped ~6x for a small set of customers. Stack looks like: cache miss -> fetch multiple model variants -> heavy kernel warmups -> queueing.

sam: Oof. Any obvious trigger? new key normalization?

alex: Yep. Two changes landed in the same deploy: 1) kernel selector now prefers variant-B for short contexts, and 2) cache key normalization tightened (strip trailing whitespace + normalize punctuation). The tightened keying reduced dedup for some prompt families.

emi: Paging profiling numbers I grabbed from the hot node:
```
hot-node-12: prefix-cache miss rate 67% -> prefetch fanout 420 req/s -> kernel-init CPU 85% -> avg p99 latency 3.4s
prefetch latency breakdown: kv-store 40%, model-variant-resolve 30%, kernel-init 25%, other 5%
```

alex: The worst bit: the kernel-init path is launching heavy quantized kernels per-variant even for requests that will be short; warmup cost is amortized poorly.

jia: Can we throttle prefetch fanout or reduce variant explosion? Emergency toggle to limit fanout to N variants would help. Also consider fast-path fallback to small shared kernel instead of variant-B on misses.

sam: +1 for emergency throttle. What's the config surface?

emi: Current prefchain config lives in runtime flags:
```
runtime.flags.cache_prefetch_max_variants=10
runtime.flags.kernel_preference=variant_based
runtime.flags.key_normalization=strict
```
If we set cache_prefetch_max_variants=2 and temporarily set kernel_preference=fallback_shared, we can cut downstream RPS by ~60% in my back-of-envelope.

deploy-bot: [deployment] rollout/2026-03-18-kernel-select v2 -> canary started (canary=5%) :rocket:

alex: Can we pause the rollout? This looks like the canary missed the edge case.

ops-bot: Pausing rollout via deploy control plane... done. Canary instances replaced with previous image. :white_check_mark:

jia: I'll open a short-lived feature-flag patch to clamp prefetch variants and revert strict key normalization for a minute while we triage. Proposed patch in prodops:
```
featureflags.cache_key_normalization = relaxed
featureflags.prefetch_variant_limit = 2
```
Apply via ff rollout to affected orgs first.

sam: Also propose we add a quick heuristic: if prefetch fanout > 100 req/s for a single org, auto-throttle to 1 variant and enable shared-kernel fallback. That prevents a single customer from melting backend.

emi: Agreed. I can add a circuit-breaker metric in the proxy and a short-term rule. Willing to test on staging then ship to prod hot path (low-risk change).

alex: Good. Parallel asks: 1) revert strict key normalization to recover hit-rate, 2) clamp variant prefetch to 2, 3) enable shared-kernel fallback for misses, 4) add alert for per-org prefetch > 100 rps.

ops-bot: Hotfix patch applied to prod: relaxed key normalization and prefetch_variant_limit=2 for affected regions. Rollback of kernel-select already done. Monitoring: https://grafana.internal/redwood/runtime/cache-prefetch (watching).

emi: After hotfix: miss rate dropped from 67% -> 18% on that node, backend prefetch RPS down 6x -> 1.2x baseline. p99 latency down to 720ms.

sam: Nice. Next steps: longer-term we need better simulation in canary for keyspace changes and kernel-selection interactions. Also add pre-deploy perf test that exercises combinatorial key-normalization + kernel selector flags.

jia: I'll write the ff patch and a brief postmortem doc. For rollout safety: add automated canary traffic that mimics top-50 prompt families so we catch these degenerative cases.

alex: Thanks all. Emi, can you run a small repro harness against staging to validate shared-kernel fallback doesn’t regress quality? Put results in #eng-runtime when ready.

emi: On it, will post numbers in ~45m.

alex: :thumbsup: Great incident handling — no customer-impacting errors, just perf pain. Follow-up: small postmortem and a couple of mitigation PRs.

deploy-bot: [note] next action: schedule rollback window if any regressions in 24h.

jia: Filed the action items: https://tickets.internal/RINF-2417 (triage + followups).

sam: Closing loop: add a test that validates kernel-selection + key-normalization combos to CI matrix.

ops-bot: Monitoring note: set alert threshold lowered to 50 rps for per-org prefetch, creating early warning. :rotating_light:
